text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First place went to Shinko Windy. Not a 
soul present could deny that her strength 
was the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the race, Shinko Windy was all 
the public could talk about. The day she'd 
shock everyone with her pranks was drawing 
near...!
